# chipManager

> Claude Code mod: a panel where agents propose work as actions ("chips") that the owner reviews and starts as
> sessions on Claude, Codex or external models, locally, in the cloud or on API credits, under lane rules R0–R5.

Agents interact through five MCP tools: `suggerisci_azione` (propose), `aggiorna_azione` (report delivery and
review), `risorse_agenti` (read limits and rules), `proponi_pesi` and `proponi_impostazioni` (only on user request).
Settings have an Account layer shared by all projects and a Project layer that can only restrict it. The mod can be
installed for all projects or for one (`claude plugin install chip-manager@chipmanager --scope user|project|local`).

## Docs

- [Guide for agents](docs/GUIDE-FOR-AGENTS.md): lifecycle, briefs, lanes, model and effort choice, reporting, platforms
- [Agents snippet](docs/AGENTS-SNIPPET.md): short block to paste into CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md
- [README](README.md): install per project or globally, account and project settings, routing.json, limits and
  balancing, security guards

## Optional

- [Agent UX review](docs/AGENT-UX-REVIEW.md): findings and proposals on tool texts, schemas and mandate
